plotEn:
A summit in Madrid is attacked by heavily armed and well organised terrorists. The US President escapes in “The Beast” with Taft, an injured Secret Service agent, but the rest of his detail and Counter Assault Team are killed. Taking control of the car, the President is directed over comms by Secret Service Command to an extraction point whilst Taft treats his injuries. The attackers gun down civilians in the street, and it becomes clear they are aware of all Secret Service contingencies. Command advises that Morón Air Base and Naval Station Rota were also attacked, halting air support, and other attacks are taking place throughout Europe with conflicting and contradictory intel on the perpetrators. 
The President activates The Beast’s offensive countermeasures, killing two waves of terrorists. Command updates that the Vice President, UK Prime Minister and Turkish President have been killed. The President reassures Taft that his injuries, similar to ones sustained by a friend in the Vietnam War, are survivable, and how his wife, Rosa, helped him overcome his PTSD. He later performs rudimentary surgery to prevent Taft going into hemorrhagic shock. Command is attacked and communications cease, but the terrorists broadcast a reading of The Second Coming as part of their manifesto. When The Beast is cornered in a tunnel, the President deploys a railgun to clear the way.
